profile.summary: The California Department of Rehabilitation is a state agency that provides employment and independent living services to Californians with disabilities. It also serves students with disabilities, including through Transition Partnership Programs that work with school districts under cooperative agreements to prepare students for employment.

sources.title: Contact Us - California Department of Rehabilitation

review.notes: The agenda names the State of California Department of Rehabilitation, and dor.ca.gov is that state agency. Its Transition Partnership Programs run through cooperative agreements with school districts, which fits OUSD's Special Education agreements. The cited pages show the summary, website, phone (1-800-952-5544), P.O. Box address and Sacramento headquarters. The summary is neutral.
